libusb
======

  repository  https://github.com/libusb/libusb
  tag         v1.0.29  (commit 15a7ebb4d426c5ce196684347d2b7cafad862626)
  fetched     2026-09-30
  licence     LGPL-2.1-or-later (COPYING)

The same version ATK's get_hackrf.bat builds. Vendored: libusb/*.c and *.h,
the Windows backend (os/*windows*), the two POSIX headers libusbi.h names,
libusb-1.0.def, and msvc/config.h. build.bat compiles it into its OWN DLL,
bin\libusb-1.0.dll, beside atkdaq.exe - kept dynamic so the LGPL's
relinking terms are met by construction. On Linux the system libusb is
used instead.

The KrakenSDR's five RTL2832U interfaces need the WinUSB driver (Zadig) for
libusb to open them; see README.md, "First run".
